item.title: Iran says U.S. election results show Americans reject the war
item.description: As the war Trump launched with Israel against Iran drags into month nine, he acknowledges its role in the GOP's election defeat but says he'd have done it anyway.

item.title: Indiana carries out first of 3 U.S. executions set for Thursday
item.description: An Indiana man was executed in the first of three lethal injections scheduled for Thursday in the U.S., which would mark the second time this year that three people in the U.S. were put to death on the same day.

item.title: Did Republican efforts to redistrict the House turn into a dummymander?
item.description: Republicans undertook a historic effort to redraw several states' Congressional districts mid-decade in an attempt to maintain control of the House.

item.title: All the House districts that flipped in the midterm elections
item.description: Democrats won control of the House on Tuesday by flipping more than two dozen Republican-held seats, picking up perennial swing districts and seats that were once considered deep-red.

item.title: Midterm fallout begins after Democrats win control of Congress
item.description: The impact of Democrats' sweeping victories in the 2026 midterm elections is already being felt in Washington. Follow live updates here.

item.title: Democrats win Senate control — live updates
item.description: Democrats were able to pick up the seats needed to gain control of the Senate, CBS News projects, and the party scored several upset victories in red states.

item.title: Democrats win House majority with Trump approval at historic low
item.description: Democrats won control of the House in the 2026 midterm elections, CBS News projects, with victories in battleground districts across the country.

item.title: 2 Native American women make history in midterms
item.description: In New Mexico, former Interior Secretary Deb Haaland was elected governor, making her the first Native American woman elected to lead a U.S. state. In Minnesota, Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan became the first Native American woman senator.

item.title: Presidential historian calls Democrats' midterm wins "history in the making"
item.description: Presidential historian Douglas Brinkley joins "The Daily Report" to break down the significance of Democrats' sweeping midterm victories.

item.title: Stock markets surge as Democrats win control of House, Senate
item.description: Markets surged Wednesday following Democrats' sweeping victories in Tuesday's midterm elections. CBS News business contributor Javier David reports.

item.title: What comes next as Democrats win House, Senate
item.description: Democrats are set to control both the House and Senate in the new Congress following a series of historic midterm victories. CBS News' Caitlin Huey-Burns reports.

item.title: Vance blames Iran war for midterm losses, Trump agrees but says Iran couldn't have nuke
item.description: Vice President JD Vance posted on social media Wednesday that Republican's midterm losses were due to the war in Iran. President Trump said he agrees with that, but that he couldn't allow Iran to have a nuclear weapon. CBS News' Natalie Brand reports.

item.title: Republicans look for answers after Democrats' sweeping midterm wins
item.description: Republicans are picking up the pieces after Democrats scored multiple historic wins in the midterms. CBS News' Zak Hudak reports and strategists Cameron French and Keith Sheridan join "The Daily Report" to discuss.

item.title: Mississippi Senate race still too close to call with 95% of ballots counted
item.description: The Mississippi Senate race between Scott Colom and Cindy Hyde-Smith is still too close to call the day after Tuesday's midterm elections. Austin Park, editor-in-chief at VoteHub, joins "The Daily Report" to discuss.

item.title: Alaska Senate race still undecided, Peltola and Sullivan separated by slim margin
item.description: Votes are still being counted in Alaska's Senate race between incumbent Republican Dan Sullivan and Democrat Mary Peltola. CBS News' Taurean Small reports.

item.title: Mississippi Senate race is toss-up, with razor-thin margin
item.description: The Senate race in deep-red Mississippi remains unresolved Wednesday morning, as Democrat Scott Colom has mounted a surprisingly competitive challenge to incumbent Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith.

item.title: What to expect from Congress after Democrats win both House and Senate
item.description: A new era is coming in Washington after Democrats made historic wins in Tuesday's midterm elections to take back the House and Senate. CBS News' Arden Farhi breaks it down.

item.title: President Trump reacts to Democrats winning the House and Senate
item.description: President Trump has no regrets about his war with Iran, despite CBS News projecting that Democrats will win both the House and Senate in the midterm elections. Weijia Jiang reports.

item.title: DNC vice chair Shasti Conrad on what Tuesday's midterm wins mean for the party
item.description: Democratic National Committee vice chair Shasti Conrad joins "The Takeout" to offer her thoughts on the Democrats' midterm wins and what it means for the DNC.

item.title: Muddy footprint leads searchers to find missing 6-year-old
item.description: More than 300 volunteers on foot and horseback, as well as several law enforcement agencies, took part in an around-the-clock search for the child.

item.title: 6-year-old with autism Roman Heilman found after going missing for days in Kentucky
item.description: Six-year-old Roman Heilam went missing in Kentucky over the weekend after wandering away from his home, but was found by responders on horseback. Ian Lee has the story.

item.title: DFL trifecta 2.0: Democrats win full control of Minnesota government
item.description: Democrats flipped the Minnesota House and won the governor's race, returning the DFL to a trifecta after two years of divided government. The results, however, remain unofficial.

item.title: Latest on Detroit Lions linebacker Jack Campbell's recovery after dramatic neck injury
item.description: Detroit Lions linebacker Jack Campbell put out an encouraging statement Wednesday after suffering a severe neck injury. Mark Strassman reports.

item.title: 11/4: CBS Evening News
item.description: Trump reacts to midterms defeat; Talarico, Hinojosa win Texas.

item.title: Rep. Hillary Scholten on Abdul El-Sayed's Senate victory, Democrats' huge midterm gains
item.description: Michigan Democratic Rep. Hillary Scholten won reelection Tuesday night. She joins "The Takeout" to discuss her win, Abdul El-Sayed's Senate race victory and midterm wins by Democrats across the country.

item.title: McDonald's plans to cook up cheaper menu items as sales slow
item.description: McDonald's CEO Christopher Kempczinski said the company is testing new value options at select U.S. locations.

item.title: 11/4: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: Democrats' midterm wins surpass post-Watergate gains; Mississippi and Alaska Senate races still too close to call.

item.title: Huge space telescope plunges back to Earth after 22 years in orbit
item.description: NASA had previously said much of the observatory burned up upon reentry. The risk to people on Earth was low, the agency said.

item.title: Tennessee murderer captured over a week after escaping prison
item.description: Jacob Morley was serving a life sentence at the Northwest Correctional Complex in Tennessee when he escaped by slipping through a fence on the property.

item.title: JetBlue hikes baggage fees for the second time this year
item.description: Airlines have raised baggage fees and ticket prices to help offset the surging cost of jet fuel this year.
